description: Codex projection of the org guardrails. SELF-CONTAINED: every path is under $PLUGIN_ROOT, the directory Codex unpacks this plugin into — referencing a checkout would make enforcement depend on a tree the plugin does not own, and on it still being there. Verified 2026-07 against codex-cli 0.146.0: the injected variable is PLUGIN_ROOT (there is no CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is kept as an alias). Codex's hooks parser accepts only `description` and `hooks` — a `//` comment key is rejected outright (it warns and skips the whole file, so the guardrail is silently absent). INSTALLING DOES NOT ENABLE ENFORCEMENT: an untrusted hook is SILENTLY SKIPPED. Trust it once in the interactive TUI (/hooks). Editing this file changes its content-bound hash, which can require re-trusting.
